page_title: WOL 0-4 MCI | Wolves v Manchester City 16/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+8' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Wolves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+4' Nico (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+2' The ball rebounds back to Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) on the edge of the box and he produces another shot, just to see it fly wide of the target.
90+2' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall.
90+1' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Joao Gomes (Wolves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Manchester City are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
87' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
82' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. John Stones is replaced by Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City).
82' A substitution has been made. Jorgen Strand Larsen is replaced by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
81' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
81' 0 - 4 Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!
77' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
74' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
73' Substitution. Erling Haaland leaves the pitch and is replaced by Rayan Cherki (Manchester City).
73' Vitor Pereira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jhon Arias (Wolves) replacing Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.
73' Here comes a substitution. Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Ki-Jana Hoever.
72' Here is a change. Andre is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Fernando Lopez (Wolves).
72' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing David Moller Wolfe.
67' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Matt Doherty (Wolves), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
66' Substitution. Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) replaces Bernardo Silva.
66' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) replaces Jeremy Doku.
66' Here's the change. Rico Lewis leaves the pitch and Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.

61' 0 - 3 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. Tijjani Reijnders assisted in the goal. 0:3.
59' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

58' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the top of the net, but James Trafford makes a magnificent save! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jarred Gillett didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
53' Rayan Ait Nouri (Manchester City) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
51' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
49' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for an infringement.
45+4' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
45+2' Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester City comes to nothing.
43' Manchester City take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Manchester City win a corner.
43' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.

37' 0 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Oscar Bobb, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City), who beats Jose Sa with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
34' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Rico Lewis sprays a pass out to Erling Haaland (Manchester City), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
34' Nico (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
33' Rayan Ait Nouri (Manchester City) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
33' Nico (Manchester City) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
29' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is flagged for offside.
26' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
20' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
20' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
18' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
17' Andre (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
13' Andre (Wolves) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' John Stones (Manchester City) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
7' John Stones (Manchester City) attempts to find Jeremy Doku, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
4' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
2' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
1' A lofted cross from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Manchester City earn a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett is the one to supervise the game today.
